subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should `operator.questions`, the five `question.*` RPCs, two question broadcasts, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` ship now as stable public contracts?
rationale: The contracts cross Gateway authorization, client protocol, channel-plugin, and public Plugin SDK boundaries; correctness repairs are mechanical, but automation cannot decide whether this full surface should become permanent API in this release.

options.title: Approve the narrow contracts
options.body: Keep the additive protocol and SDK surface, require all four blocking repairs plus rebase and fresh changed-surface proof before merge.

options.title: Keep the first slice internal
options.body: Remove or internalize the public SDK/operator surface and land only the minimum bundled runtime until external contract requirements are settled.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow contracts
recommendation.body: Keep the additive protocol and SDK surface, require all four blocking repairs plus rebase and fresh changed-surface proof before merge.
